brand_identity.name: Export Monde Prestige Inc. (EMP)
brand_identity.tagline_fr: Solutions numériques | Ingénierie | Gestion de projets | Construction | Approvisionnements
brand_identity.tagline_en: Digital Solutions | Engineering | Project Management | Construction | Procurement
brand_identity.positioning: Canadian digital engineering and construction project management firm operating in Ontario, Ottawa, and Quebec.
brand_identity.emotional_tone: Authoritative, Swiss-structured, high-tech engineering precision, sober elegance, zero fluff, instant B2B trust within 5 seconds.

rules: Never use dark gradients flat on full screens; dark blue #0B132B as solid grounded surfaces with precise 1px borders (#1E293B or rgba(255,255,255,0.1)).
Accent color electric blue (#2563EB) and turquoise (#06B6D4) reserved exclusively for active states, kinetic borders, interactive indicators, and primary CTAs.
High contrast text: Light surfaces use #0F172A text; dark surfaces use #FFFFFF or #F8FAFC.

typography.heading_font: Outfit or Barlow Condensed, sans-serif (Display precision, bold tracking-tight)
typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans or DM Sans, sans-serif (High legibility, modern corporate)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, monospace (For stats, operational codes, BIM coordinates, contract data)

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-none
hierarchy.overlines: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-mono text-blue-600 font-semibold

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous padding system: section spacing py-20 lg:py-32, container px-4 sm:px-8 lg:px-12
bento_grid_rules: Tetris Bento for Home services & operational advantages: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8
Hero cell: col-span-full md:col-span-8 row-span-2 with dark blue precision card
High-density grid for Admin Dashboard and Cost Estimation widgets: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4

motion_and_interactions.hero_kinetic_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion (staggerChildren: 0.1, duration: 0.8)
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Framer motion viewport once: opacity 0 to 1, y 20 to 0
motion_and_interactions.editorial_marquee: Slow, smooth drifting marquee for industry standard compliance (PMI, BIM ISO 19650, Red Seal, PEO, OQ)
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Subtle translate-y (-2px) on hover with border highlight and accent shadow.

home: Header with EMP monogram logo, FR/EN toggle, sticky glassmorphic backdrop (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-950/80)
Kinetic Hero section with line reveal, Canadian engineering imagery, search/quote trigger
Bento Grid: 6 Core Engineering & Management Domains
Challenges vs EMP Solutions (Interactive comparison split canvas)
5-Step Method Timeline (Audit, Plan, Execute, Control, Handover)
Operational Advantages (Cost efficiency, digital compliance, risk mitigation)
Sectors Grid (Industrial, Civil Infrastructure, Commercial, Energy, Government)
Company Intro (Canadian roots: Ontario, Ottawa, Quebec)
Final High-Impact CTA Block & Full Multi-column Footer
key_pages_structure.service_pages: 6 distinct detail pages (Solutions numériques, Gestion de projet construction, Estimation & contrôle des coûts, Planification de projet, Approvisionnement & coordination, Gestion des appels d'offres) with Problem, Solution, Deliverables, Benefits, Process, and Direct Quote CTA.
key_pages_structure.sectors_page: Detailed breakdown of 5 industrial & engineering sectors served in Ontario and Quebec.
key_pages_structure.about_page: Mission, Vision, Values, Method, Regional Commitment (Canada), Leadership & Ethics.
key_pages_structure.contact_quote_page: Interactive multi-step quote request form with scope selector, budget, file attachment mock, direct contacts.
key_pages_structure.resources_blog: Filterable articles list & detail view covering construction digital transformation, cost management, and Canadian regulations.
key_pages_structure.admin_dashboard: Protected admin space with Lead Management table (filters, status updates, export) and Article Publishing Editor.

general_ui_ux_guidelines.test_id_attribute: MUST add data-testid on every button, link, form input, navigation item, card, filter, language switcher, modal, and key data point using kebab-case role naming.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.i18n_support: Full Bilingual FR (Primary) / EN support with seamless state context switcher in header.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.shadcn_components: Use custom-styled Shadcn UI components for dialogs, accordions, tabs, dropdowns, forms, tables, and sonner toasts.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.no_fake_elements: No fake countdown timers, no fake customer testimonials. Use authentic methodology highlights, clear deliverable specs, and Canadian compliance details.
